subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord message edits and deletes become default bundled-plugin behavior for reprocessing commands and canceling source-message runs?
rationale: Current main lacks the behavior and the implementation belongs in the Discord plugin, but default cancellation/reprocessing semantics affect session state and message delivery enough to need maintainer acceptance before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept default-on Discord lifecycle behavior
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR direction after live Discord proof and review confirm edits supersede only the source message run and deletes cancel only that exact run.

options.title: Require an opt-in or narrower scope
options.body: Ask the PR to keep existing behavior as default or narrow the feature if automatic edit/delete handling is too surprising for existing Discord operators.

options.title: Defer to broader channel design
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the linked PR if maintainers want edit/delete cancellation solved as a cross-channel contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on Discord lifecycle behavior
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR direction after live Discord proof and review confirm edits supersede only the source message run and deletes cancel only that exact run.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main history owner for the Discord monitor/gateway runtime surfaces involved in the decision.
